core_obligations: The 2-fibre product S_U x_{[U/R]} (Sch/T) is representable by an algebraic space F (diagonal lemmas).
Smoothness and surjectivity are local on the target in the fppf topology; choose a covering {T_i -> T} trivializing x, so it suffices to treat x coming from a morphism x: T -> U.
Rewrite S_U x_{[U/R]} (Sch/T) = (S_U x_{[U/R]} S_U) x_{S_U} (Sch/T) = S_R x_{S_U} (Sch/T) by the erase-factor and 2-cartesian lemmas.
Identify the last 2-fibre product with R x_{s,U,x} T; it is smooth as a base change of s and surjective since s has the identity section e.
proof_roadmap: Representability; fppf-local reduction; 2-fibre rewriting chain; base-change smoothness with the section argument.
difficulty_reason: The fppf-local reduction plus the 2-fibre rewriting chain and the section argument are the substance.
